relationships.subject: Nav1.9
relationships.evidence_quote: Gain-of-function SCN11A mutations cause FEP type III.

key_findings: Review: gain-of-function Nav1.9 changes cause hyperexcitability of small DRG neurons and Dogiel II ENS neurons, linked to intestinal hyperpathia and dysmotility.
Scn11a knockout mice show reduced afferent responses to ATP and PGE2 and reduced inflammatory colorectal hyperalgesia.
